bijan_zzz: Nils "Mud" Zzz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
domgas_1: Day 8: Dietrich "Spark" Domgas reached R-S16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
faccio.stefano: The draft reached R-C10 on Day 9. Gustav "Mud" Stefano was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
george_jackson2004: Dietrich Jackson came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Dietrich Jackson received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dietrich Jackson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dietrich Jackson spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Dietrich Jackson got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Dietrich Jackson spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F10 with the rations. Dietrich Jackson ate while listening to the revised orders.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F10 and grazed Dietrich Jackson's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88).
Dietrich Jackson no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Dietrich Jackson wrote back to Clara and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Dietrich Jackson sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
gmt_zhai: Yann Zhai reached R-R3 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
kurlkale: Felix "Bones" Kurlkale reached S-C11 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
realvirtuality: Tobias Realvirtuali came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
samot0423: Roland Samot reached T-F21 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
tru_og_fokai: Dietrich Fokai unpacked a rosary of rough beads at S-R14. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
